entries.title: II Kings 15:5
segments: Smote the king; for his pride and presumption in attempting to burn incense to the Lord in the temple.
A several house; a retired building, where he was separated from the rest of the inhabitants.

entries.title: II Kings 15:9
segments: The sins of rulers and distinguished persons are often the means of destruction to their distant posterity, and to multitudes of others who imitate their wicked example.

entries.title: II Kings 15:11
segments: Zachariah; he was the fourth of the descendants of Jehu.

entries.title: II Kings 15:14
segments:
Menahem; supposed to have been one of the generals of Zachariah. 
 
  Tirzah; a city of the tribe of Ephraim, for a time the capital of the ten tribes.

entries.title: II Kings 15:16
segments: Tiphsah; supposed to have been in Ephraim.  A place of this name was situated on the Euphrates, and was taken possession of by Solomon.

entries.title: II Kings 15:29
segments:
Ijon--Naphtali; the places here mentioned were in the north part of the land of Israel. 
 
When the people of God rebel against them, the wicked are suffered to overcome and oppress them; nor without repentance and reformation can they escape destruction.

entries.title: II Kings 15:30
segments: The twentieth year of Jotham; as Jotham reigned but sixteen years,

, it has been supposed that the sacred writer here means, in the twentieth year from the time when Jotham came to the throne: Ahaz his successor not being named, because the history of his reign has not yet been reached.
